gen-megrim-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One has an oversized lowercase and a hung-out spacing. Megrim sits above it, all angular wire-thin strokes, so a long stretch of text feels like laser-cut sheet beneath a futuristic sign.
gen-megrim-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Megrim draws every stroke at one measured thickness, which makes it look like a futuristic blueprint. And Mochiy Pop P One lets its roomy, generously spaced sans lowercase carry the text without any brushy swelling to compete.
gen-megrim-gf-montserrat-underline: Megrim is all angular, futuristic wire. Its job is to look striking and strange up top, while Montserrat Underline handles the text with breathing counters and round bowls of uniform walls.
gen-megrim-gf-mozilla-headline: Futuristic and angular, Megrim keeps its line at wire thickness. Mozilla Headline fills out beneath it with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so the two feel like a sharp sketch next to a friendly, contemporary voice.
gen-megrim-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans has a large central band and curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths. Megrim is best at angular, futuristic display, while Nata Sans does its best work in the text line with a technical-pen steadiness.
gen-megrim-gf-nobile: Nobile reads in a professional, contemporary way, with capitals barely above the lowercase and open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. Megrim is the showpiece with arches matching its stems; Nobile is the workhorse.
gen-megrim-gf-nokora: Approachable and clean, Nokora lays down a dark stripe of lowercase with a wide-open s that never tightens. And Megrim, with its stroke at one width, stays light above it, so a long page feels grounded yet futuristic.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Modern and clean, Megrim draws a monoweight stroke in angular, futuristic display shapes. Noto Kufi Arabic follows with a welcoming open gap in its c, and you can give its size a little extra room.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of the letter height with its lowercase and keeps a wide-open c, a plain sans for the text. Megrim stays angular and stylus-thin above it, a spiky futuristic neighbor.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Thin outlines meet generous curves here, with Megrim angular and futuristic up top. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and its c, s and z tall, so a long passage reads cleanly.
